records.title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
records.reason: The abstract studies repeated-data overfitting during MoE training, not inference/serving optimization.

records.title: Training Trajectories Determine Circuit Removability in Annealable Soft-Prior Transformers
records.reason: The paper analyzes transformer circuit removability as determined by training trajectories; it does not optimize LLM inference or serving.

records.title: A self-adaptive top token transformer for gastrointestinal endoscopy image restoration
records.reason: Publisher material identifies a gastrointestinal endoscopy image-restoration model that adaptively selects visual tokens and fuses frequency-domain features, evaluated on image-restoration datasets. Its reported application is medical image super-resolution/denoising, not an LLM or language-model serving workload. The accessible publisher text notes failure on severely blurred images and instrument deformation.

records.title: A Cost-Efficient Routing Pipeline for Multilingual Short-Text Classification Using Small Language Models
records.reason: The method routes compact multilingual sentence-encoder classification by language/resource tier and sometimes invokes translation; its evidence concerns narrow classification systems rather than LLM generation, general LLM serving, or model-compute optimization. The adjacency to cost-aware inference routing is weak and the task/model family mismatch remains unresolved.

records.title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
records.reason: The paper benchmarks long-horizon office-suite agents and economic grounding; it is a task benchmark, not an inference/serving method.
